title: 第25章 下棋第26章 下棋2
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
穆贺说道：“爱卿你输了。”
昔小苑想怂了，也不知道他会惩罚她什么，这丫的最好轻一点，但是他这么腹黑这么有心机，怎么可能会轻呢？？？
昔小苑故作镇定的说道：“那皇上打算怎么惩罚呢~”
穆贺一脸惬意的模样，缓缓说道：“爱卿别这么紧张嘛，朕就罚爱卿挑支舞如何？！！”
昔小苑微微一笑的答应了，他那语气，她哪里敢不从，他根本就不是问她的意见，简直就是下命令~~
别看他说的温柔，实则话里藏刀呢……
昔小苑整理了一下衣服，而后对皇上说道：“臣不会跳舞的，但是既然输了，那臣就只能乱跳了～”
穆贺一脸的兴趣说道：“无碍，无碍。”
看看爱卿能跳成什么样。
昔小苑活动了下筋骨，下人已经拿来了琴，随后昔小苑对一旁的奴婢说道：“奏乐……”
昔小苑跟着节奏乱跳，而且点都卡的上，她听着音乐的感觉走……
感觉自己好无语，在那乱跳，突然都觉得有些放不开手脚了，一个个的看着她跳，不管了！要的就是脸皮厚一点。
只要气势在，应该没有人会吐槽她吧？？
穆贺一手撑着脑袋看着昔小苑跳着，虽然不知道她跳的是什么意思，但是姿势跳的还不错，就是觉得像在群魔乱舞……
微风拂过，白色的布帘飘呀飘的，给昔小苑添了一道靓丽的风采，而后还有外面湖上传来的波涛水声……
奏乐一停，昔小苑抹了抹额头上的细汗，都怪自己平时不运动，就跳了一会就出汗了，还有些累……
昔小苑喘了下小气说道：“皇上臣跳完了。”
穆贺的手撑着脑袋，一脸笑意的看着昔小苑，吐槽的说道：“虽然不知爱卿跳的是什么，即使爱卿不会跳，然而还把一首曲子给跳完了，实在是勇气可嘉……”
昔小苑眉头一挑，这实在损她，还是在夸她？？？
昔小苑觉得他是在拐着弯说她脸皮厚，但是她也不问拐着弯骂他，所以还得要憋下去，随后还要一脸微笑的说道：“谢皇上夸奖。”

穆贺手势示意昔小苑过去坐下，而后还一脸惬意的说道：“爱卿还要在来吗？”
昔小苑拿起茶杯喝了口茶，继而说道：“当然！”
俩人又开启一轮比拼，昔小苑经过上两局的失败也学聪明了，这局又是一场硬仗，昔小苑都要变成狡猾的狐狸了。
随后她趁穆贺一个不注意，立马下了一个棋，她这棋一下……穆贺不管堵哪边，她都能赢。
这局昔小苑终于扳回一局了，嘿嘿嘿！终于要到她惩罚他了，嘿嘿嘿……
穆贺知道自己输了，他一脸无害的样子说道：“爱卿…你！打算怎么惩罚朕呢？！嗯～？”
昔小苑感觉穆贺在恐吓他，而且特别是他那一脸无害的样子……一看他就是再说‘你要罚什么你可得掂量掂量了’
昔小苑想哭，一个个的都欺负她，什么人呀！以大欺小，摆明了～
过分。
昔小苑有些怂的傻笑着，说道：“呵呵呵~那个…皇上…要不~”
穆贺一脸笑意的说道：“爱卿有话就直说……”
content_en:
Mu He said: "Aiqing, you lose."
Xi Xiaoyuan was scared, and she didn't know what he would punish her for. It would be better for her to be gentle, but he was so sinister and scheming, how could he punish her lightly? ? ?
Xi Xiaoyuan pretended to be calm and said: "Then how will the emperor punish you~"
Mu He looked contented and said slowly: "Don't be so nervous, my dear, how about I punish your dear to dance?!"
Xi Xiaoyuan agreed with a slight smile. With his tone, she didn't dare to disobey him. He wasn't asking for her opinion at all, he was simply giving an order~~
Despite the gentleness he said, there was actually a hidden meaning behind his words...
Xi Xiaoyuan tidied up her clothes, and then said to the emperor: "I can't dance, but since I lost, I can only dance around~"
Mu He said with interest: "No problem, no problem."
See what Aiqing can do.
Xi Xiaoyuan stretched out his muscles and bones, and the servants had already brought the piano. Then Xi Xiaoyuan said to the slaves on the side: "Play music..."
Xi Xiaoyuan danced wildly to the rhythm, and her clicks were stuck. She listened to the feeling of the music...
I felt so speechless. I was jumping around, and suddenly I felt like I couldn't let go. I watched her dance one by one and didn't care! All you need is a thicker skin.
As long as her momentum is there, no one will complain about her, right? ?
Mu He held his head with one hand and watched Xi Xiaoyuan dance. Although he didn't know what she meant by dancing, her posture was pretty good, but she felt like she was dancing with a group of demons...
The breeze blew, and the white curtains fluttered, adding a beautiful style to Xi Xiaoyuan, and then there was the sound of waves from the lake outside...
As soon as the music stopped, Xi Xiaoyuan wiped the sweat from her forehead. She blamed herself for not exercising, so she was sweating after dancing for a while, and she was still a little tired...
Xi Xiaoyuan took a breath and said, "Your Majesty has finished dancing."
Mu He supported his head with his hands, looked at Xi Xiaoyuan with a smile on his face, and complained: "Although I don't know what Aiqing danced, even though Aiqing can't dance, she still danced to the end of a song. It's really courageous..."
Xi Xiaoyuan raised her eyebrows. Was this really hurting her, or was she praising her? ? ?
Xi Xiaoyuan felt that he was going around the corner to say she was thick-skinned, but she didn't bother to scold him around the corner, so she had to hold it in, and then said with a smile: "Thank you, Your Majesty, for the compliment."
Mu He gestured for Xi Xiaoyuan to come over and sit down, and then said with a contented look, "Ai Qing, are you still here?"
Xi Xiaoyuan picked up the tea cup and took a sip of tea, then said: "Of course!"
The two started another round of competition. Xi Xiaoyuan has learned wisely after the failures in the previous two rounds. This round is another tough battle, and Xi Xiaoyuan is about to turn into a cunning fox.
Then, when Mu He wasn't paying attention, she immediately played a chess move. With her move... no matter which side Mu He blocked, she could win.
In this game, Xi Xiaoyuan finally got back a win, hey hey hey! It was finally time for her to punish him, hehehe...
Mu He knew that he had lost, and he said with a harmless look on his face: "Ai Qing... you! How are you going to punish me?! Hmm~?"
Xi Xiaoyuan felt that Mu He was intimidating him, especially with his harmless look... When he looked at him, he said, "You have to weigh the punishment you want."
Xi Xiaoyuan wanted to cry, everyone was bullying her, who were they? Using the big to bully the small is clear~
Too much.
Xi Xiaoyuan smiled sheepishly and said: "Hehehe~ That...emperor...how about~"
Mu He said with a smile on his face: "If you have anything to say, Aiqing, just say it..."
